misses.missedIssue: A goalie cover must explicitly include the whistle/stoppage. My answer allowed a pressure read after the cover and did not state that play stops.
misses.lesson: For any covered-puck hypothetical, distinguish cover from whistle and never imply continued pressure after the whistle.

misses.missedIssue: Reaching the puck first does not establish possession or control. My reasoning silently converted arrival into control.
misses.lesson: Do not infer possession from proximity, arrival order, or first contact; the hypothetical must explicitly state control.
